name: Leadership
Description: Inspire allies and lead groups with confidence.
Effect: Party members gain +5% to all stats while you are party leader.

name: Performance
Description: Entertain crowds with music, storytelling, or acting.
Effect: Earns gold from crowds; can distract NPCs for stealth opportunities.

name: Deception
Description: Lie and misdirect to manipulate situations.
Effect: NPC believes false information; success based on CHA vs INT.

name: Insight
Description: Read people to detect lies and understand true intentions.
Effect: Detects lies and hidden intentions; reveals NPC disposition.

name: Streetwise
Description: Navigate the underworld and understand criminal operations.
Effect: Access to black market vendors; understand criminal rumors and info.

name: Etiquette
Description: Know proper behavior in noble courts and formal settings.
Effect: Gains favor with nobility; access to exclusive social events and quests.

name: Gossip
Description: Gather rumors and information through casual conversation.
Effect: Reveals hidden quests and NPC secrets; success based on CHA.

name: Bluff
Description: Make false statements seem believable to deceive others.
Effect: Makes NPCs believe unlikely stories; success based on CHA vs WIS.

name: Diplomacy
Description: Negotiate between hostile parties to achieve peaceful resolutions.
Effect: Reduces hostility of NPCs; can prevent or end combat diplomatically.

name: Fast Talk
Description: Speak rapidly and confidently to overwhelm and confuse.
Effect: Stuns NPC in conversation for 3 seconds; prevents them from asking questions.

name: Bribery
Description: Use金钱 to influence NPCs and gain favorable outcomes.
Effect: Guarantees success on social checks if sufficient gold is paid.

name: Inspire
Description: Rally allies with inspiring words to boost morale.
Effect: Increases party's attack and spell power by 10% for 60 seconds.

name: Taunt
Description: Provoke an enemy into attacking you recklessly.
Effect: Forces target to attack you for 4 seconds; reduces their defense by 10%.

name: Sense Motive
Description: Detect when someone is hiding their true intentions.
Effect: Always knows if an NPC is lying or hiding something important.

name: Oratory
Description: Deliver powerful speeches that move crowds to action.
Effect: Can rally NPCs to fight for you or change faction reputation.

name: Seduction
Description: Charm and attract NPCs through flirtation and allure.
Effect: Gains temporary favor with target; can access restricted areas.

name: Intimidating Presence
Description: Your very presence causes fear and unease in others.
Effect: Weak NPCs flee on sight; stronger NPCs are more cautious in dialogue.

name: Haggling
Description: Master the art of negotiation for the best deals.
Effect: Buy/sell prices improved by additional 15%; can haggle for quest rewards.

name: Reputation Management
Description: Cultivate and manage your reputation across different factions.
Effect: Reputation gains doubled; can hide negative reputation from NPCs.

name: Silver Tongue
Description: Words flow like honey, making you irresistibly convincing.
Effect: All social skill checks have +20% success rate.

name: Dealmaker
Description: Close any deal with unmatched negotiating prowess.
Effect: Buy/sell prices improved by additional 20%; can negotiate quest rewards up 50%.

name: Commander's Presence
Description: Your voice carries authority that few can ignore.
Effect: Party gains +10% to all stats; enemies have 10% chance to flee on encounter.

name: Master Manipulator
Description: Pull strings from the shadows, controlling events and people.
Effect: Can recruit NPCs as agents; manipulate faction politics remotely.

name: Legend
Description: Your reputation precedes you wherever you go.
Effect: NPCs have unique dialogue; some enemies surrender; unique quests unlocked.

name: Voice of Authority
Description: Your commands carry magical weight that compel obedience.
Effect: Target must obey one command for 8 seconds; cannot be resisted below level 15.

name: Grand Diplomat
Description: Resolve even the most dire conflicts through negotiation.
Effect: Can end wars between factions; broker peace treaties with permanent effects.

name: Sovereign
Description: Command the respect and loyalty of entire nations.
Effect: Can establish and rule a faction; NPCs offer tribute; unique endgame content.
